messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 2.5-0 released and on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
Version 2.5-00 f the NMOF package has been released
and is available from
   https://cran.r-project.org/package=NMOF
and from the Git repository at
   https://gitlab.com/NMOF/NMOF

The NEWS file entry:

  o new function 'Ritter', which downloads IPO data
    provided by Jay Ritter

  o 'gridSearch' now can handle arbitrary lists (before,
    only lists of numeric vectors were supported)

  o 'French': improve formatting of (some) datasets


Comments/corrections/remarks/suggestions are -- as
always -- very welcome; please send them to the
maintainer (me) directly.


-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://enricoschumann.net
